data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘nubu’ah which means rain or shower. In the Islamic context, it symbolizes blessings from Allah and the continuous flow of His mercy upon us. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nubugh usually hope their child will grow to embody light rain or shower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
